name: Tria Card
summary: Self-custodial cross-chain neobank card. 0% Tria fees on crypto conversions, up to 6% cashback. $1M daily limit. Tiers: Virtual $20, Signature $90, Premium $250.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Tria Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$20.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Tria Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.
